visualCharacteristics.purpose: Product area gallery: one large panel per product area, switched by a text tab strip
visualCharacteristics.layout: panel above, tab strip with prev/next arrows below; image and text side by side on desktop, alternating image side panel by panel
visualCharacteristics.notes: used in dark sections; ARIA tabs pattern with roving tabindex, arrow/Home/End keys

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: tab label (text); cell 2: product image, heading, text paragraph, CTA link (bold = primary button)

usage: 'Unsere Produkte fuer die Industrie' and 'Unsere Produkte fuer die IT' sections on the homepage.
reuseGuidance: Use for switching between a handful of product areas with one image and CTA each. Add the image-right option when the first panel should show the image on the right.
